title: Product landing page
prompt: Build a single-page marketing site for "Kettle", a coffee subscription service. It needs a hero section with the headline "Coffee, handled" and a "Start your trial" button, a three-up feature row (Fresh roasts, Flexible delivery, Cancel anytime), a pricing section with three tiers named Filter, Espresso and Barista, and a footer with the text "Kettle Coffee Co.". Make it look like a real product site.

rubric.description: The page shows a real interface, not a blank page, a loading spinner, or an error overlay.
A hero section is visible with the headline "Coffee, handled" and a call-to-action button.
Three features are laid out in a row: Fresh roasts, Flexible delivery, Cancel anytime.
A pricing section shows three distinct tiers named Filter, Espresso and Barista.
A footer is visible containing "Kettle Coffee Co.".
It reads as a designed marketing page -- consistent typography, deliberate spacing, visual hierarchy -- not stacked unstyled text.

iterations.prompt: Make the hero section background blue.
iterations.check: (() => { for (const el of document.querySelectorAll('header,section,div')) { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width < 300 || r.height < 150 || r.top > 400) continue; const m = getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor.match(/\d+/g); if (!m) continue; const [red,g,b,a] = m.map(Number); if ((a === undefined || a > 0.5) && b > 90 && b > red + 25 && b > g + 15) return true; } return false; })()

iterations.prompt: Add a fourth pricing tier called "Roastery".
iterations.description: A structural edit, not just a style token.
